#  Lenacapavir Named 2024 Breakthrough of the Year: A New Era in HIV Prevention
13 Dec 2024 | By Yulisha Naidoo 
![December 2024 Issue Cover of Science Magazine](https://idm.uct.ac.za/sites/default/files/styles/standard_lg/public/media/images/idm_uct_ac_za/science-magazine_0.jpg?h=d1cb525d&itok=fNITxrtY)
Photo: December 2024 Issue Cover of Science
13 Dec 2024 | By Yulisha Naidoo 
The fight against HIV has reached a historic milestone with _Science_ naming Lenacapavir its _2024 Breakthrough of the Year_. This innovative injectable drug, administered every six months, has demonstrated up to 99.9% efficacy in preventing HIV infections. Lenacapavir’s success represents a revolutionary step in global HIV prevention, particularly for high-risk populations, and brings new hope to millions worldwide.
Central to this groundbreaking achievement is [Professor Linda-Gail Bekker](https://idm.uct.ac.za/contacts/linda-gail-bekker), an IDM member, and world-renowned infectious disease expert. Professor Bekker led one of the pivotal efficacy trials, which focused on adolescent girls and young women in South Africa. These trials, alongside others conducted globally, have established Lenacapavir as a new benchmark in the science of HIV prevention.
“This isn’t just a drug—it’s a game-changer in how we approach HIV prevention, particularly in regions hardest hit by the epidemic,” says Professor Bekker.
The African-led trials, demonstrate the power of collaboration and local leadership in addressing global health challenges.
As regulatory processes unfold, the focus now shifts to ensuring equitable access to Lenacapavir, so its life-saving potential can be realised by all who need it. This breakthrough stands as a testament to the power of scientific innovation and the dedication of researchers like Linda-Gail Bekker in the pursuit of an HIV-free future.
Learn more about this historic breakthrough [here](https://idm.uct.ac.za/articles/2024-07-05-hiv-drug-trial-shows-injection-twice-yearly-100-effective-against-infection).
Read the original article [here](https://www.science.org/content/article/breakthrough-2024#section_breakthrough).
